name: HHG-RX
description: HHG-RX was an RX-series pilot droid that existed during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War. It could frequently be found hitch-hiking at Spaceport THX1138. It was identifiable with it giving the thumb gesture for hitchhiking and holding a pendant resembling the Marksman-H combat remote.
